mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the tightening signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within two months indicates a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales by more than 1% over three months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 2% over two months signals a contraction in supply, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% over three months, coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in the same period, signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 over three months signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Consumer Price Index by more than 0.5% over two months signals deflationary pressure, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP by more than 2% over two quarters signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal.
